Requirement: "Add bounded, path-safe reporting of rejected directories while preserving fail-closed transfer rejection."
Expected change site: `scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py` (typed exception carrying the rejected directory name) plus `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` (parse and bound the diagnostic). The intended fix must also propagate to the relay's rejection path if the original failure was raised from `claude_anthropic_relay.py`.
Evidence of absence: `UnsafeWorkspaceDirectory` is raised correctly in `scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:110` and the bash parser at `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:2203-2216` re-validates the diagnostic — that part is satisfied. But the LAST RUN DIFF claims a corresponding narrowing was applied to the relay (`except OSError:` → `except ConnectionError:`) and it is not in the file on disk (`scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:106` still catches every `OSError`). The PR description's auto-decisions block (AD-2 path) discusses error-path diagnostics but no test exercises the relay production path; the only test that mentions the change bypasses the production method.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

Requirement: "Ship regression and contract tests, including a parity test shown to fail on the reported head and pass with the fix. Record in the PR that you ran it both ways."
Expected change site: PR description (auto-decisions, narrative) plus the existing `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py::test_template_parity` regression test.
Evidence of absence: The PR description contains only `Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6255` plus the AD-1/AD-2 auto-decision block. There is no before-and-after attestation of the parity test against the reported head. The PR does add `test_review_isolation_unsafe_directory_names_bounded_dir` and `test_review_editor_prompt_explains_sandbox_limits` as regression coverage for the new bounded diagnostic and the editor prompt block, but no attestation that the parity test was observed failing on the reported head and now passes with the fix. The linked issue explicitly forbids a retry/backoff as an accepted fix; the parity test must "fail on the reported head and pass with the fix."
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
